capture_rule: Capture the complete primary open article and every linked supplementary-information record for Real-time observation of a metal complex-driven reaction intermediate using a porous protein crystal and serial femtosecond crystallography, DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-49814-9. Preserve every reported reaction-time identity, deposited structure identity, reactant, elementary structural transition, intermediate, product, occupancy or population disclosure, uncertainty, crystallographic statistic, adverse, absent or unresolved record, every deposited PDB coordinate/model record 8WZF, 8WZG, 8WZR, 8WZT and 8WZV, and the CXIDB 221 raw-data custody metadata in source order. Do not select by agreement, time, intermediate identity, structural change, occupancy, method, resolution or interpretation. Do not fit a lifetime, assume steady state, import a differential equation, interpolate an unreported time or coordinate, average structures, infer a missing intermediate or omit an unfavorable transition in the Fold law or external evidence vector.
source_selection_boundary: The DOI-identified complete article, every linked supplement, all five declared PDB deposits and CXIDB 221 custody metadata are fixed before any target-bearing full text, coordinate file, time value, intermediate measurement or structural result opens; before executable-law registration; before candidate enumeration; and before prediction-program construction. The source is selected structurally because it provides a primary experimental same-reaction sequence with multiple retained time identities and independently deposited intermediate structures. No observed time, coordinate, occupancy, intermediate, pathway result or desired agreement selects the source, row or Fold law.
